items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Auld Byas; the interviewer mentions 'Auld Byas Art, and Don Byas' in a context of correcting/clarifying a list of musicians, but the interviewee does not confirm a personal relationship.

ctx.x: Oh, have I convinced you? 'I'm All For You.' Here we are again. Teddy Wilson, John Collins, Al Hall, Jimmy Hamilton, I think this is Don -- no, let's see. George Georgia
Auld Byas Art, and Don Byas. Sure. So you see, this is sickening. I mean, I just -- I -- I just don't understand it. You know.
